message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: coverage

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '7 7 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: ros:humble-ros-base
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        env:
          DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive
        run: |
          apt-get update -qq
          apt-get install -y -qq ros-dev-tools python3-pip python3-pytest-cov > /dev/null
          pip install -q gcovr
          [ -f /etc/ros/rosdep/sources.list.d/20-default.list ] || rosdep init
          rosdep update --rosdistro humble > /dev/null
          rosdep install -y -r -q --rosdistro humble --ignore-src \
            --from-paths $(colcon list --paths-only --packages-skip aerostack2)

      - name: Build
        run: |
          source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash
          colcon build --continue-on-error --packages-skip aerostack2 \
            --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=--coverage -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=--coverage -DBUILD_TESTING=ON \
            -DAMENT_CMAKE_PYTEST_WITH_COVERAGE=ON

      - name: Test
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          source install/setup.bash
          export COVERAGE_RCFILE="$PWD/.coveragerc"
          colcon test --pytest-with-coverage --packages-skip aerostack2 \
            --ctest-args -E 'uncrustify|cpplint|flake8|pep257|xmllint|lint_cmake|copyright|cppcheck'
          colcon test-result --verbose

      - name: Report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          gcovr --object-directory build --html-details coverage/index.html --cobertura coverage/coverage.xml --print-summary

      - name: Upload HTML reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-html
          path: |
            coverage/
            build/*/coverage.html/
            build/*/pytest_cov/*/coverage.html/
          retention-days: 14

      - name: List reports
        id: reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          echo "coverage=$(find coverage/coverage.xml build -name coverage.xml | paste -sd, -)" | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tests=$(find build -path '*/test_results/*.xml' -o -name pytest.xml | paste -sd, -)" | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.repository == 'aerostack2/aerostack2' }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7.1.1
        with:
          files: ${{ steps.reports.outputs.coverage }}
          disable_search: true
          plugins: noop
          use_oidc: true
          fail_ci_if_error: true

      - name: Upload test results
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.repository == 'aerostack2/aerostack2' && steps.reports.outputs.tests != '' }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7.1.1
        with:
          report_type: test_results
          files: ${{ steps.reports.outputs.tests }}
          disable_search: true
          use_oidc: true
          fail_ci_if_error: true",
  "rationale": "The workflow re-fetches and installs dependencies (apt packages, pip gcovr, rosdep) on every scheduled and dispatch run with no caching. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) reports measured benefit for caching dependency downloads and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and the cache can be keyed on dependency inputs. Adding a single actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cache/pip before dependency installation is minimal, preserves every build/test/report step and required check, adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions, and uses restore-keys for fallback.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
